title: Farting Blocks
description: Farting Blocks adds hilarious "immersion" to Minecraft. Breaking blocks or sprinting now triggers random fart sounds and gas cloud particles. It features a built-in cooldown and randomized pitch for high-performance, non-stop fun.
body:
# Farting Blocks – A Gas-tastic Experience! 💨
Ever felt like Minecraft was just a bit too quiet? Farting Blocks adds a touch of "immersion" to your daily activities by adding hilarious sound effects and visual cues to common player actions. It’s the mod nobody asked for, but everyone needs.

## ✨ Features
Breaking Wind (literally): Every time you break a block, there is a chance to trigger a satisfying "thud" and a puff of smoke.

**Sprinting Spasms:** Running for your life from a Creeper? Don't be surprised if your character lets one slip! Sprinting has a random chance to trigger a fart effect.

**Dynamic Sounds:** Includes a custom high-quality fart sound with randomized pitch to ensure every "event" sounds unique.

**Visual Flair:** Features a smoke particle effect (the "gas cloud") that appears right at the player's position.

**Server-Side Optimized:** Built with a cooldown system to prevent sound spam and ensure smooth performance even on multiplayer servers.

## 🛠️ Technical Details
**Platform:** Fabric

**Side:** Server-side (but recommended for both for the best experience).

**Performance:** Uses ThreadLocalRandom and a UUID-based cooldown map to keep your TPS high and your smells... well, low.

## 🚀 Installation
Make sure you have the Fabric Loader installed.

Drop the 
```
farting-blocks-1.0.jar
```
 into your mods folder.

(Optional) Add a custom resource pack if you want to override the default "fart" sound with your own!

_Created with ❤️ (and a bit of gas) by crqzycat._
